title: Email API memory rising
summary: email-api memory and latency rose as downstream delivery slowed

logs: email-api WARN in-memory send buffer growing
deployments: email-api v5.0 removed bounded channel to improve throughput

runbooks.title: Unbounded producer buffer
runbooks.content: When downstream throughput falls and an in-memory queue grows, enforce bounded buffering and backpressure.

oracle.root_cause: v5.0 removed the bounded email channel, allowing messages to accumulate in memory during SMTP slowdown.
